models.reason: A validated late blight infection assessment requires hourly temperature and sustained relative humidity or leaf wetness observations. Daily averages cannot establish infection periods.
models.source: UC IPM late blight forecasting references

models.interpretation: Warm conditions and moisture indicators were observed. This suggests potentially favorable environmental conditions, but does not confirm disease infection.
models.limitation: Daily rainfall and average humidity cannot determine actual leaf wetness duration.
models.source: University of Connecticut Extension and University of Minnesota Extension

models.interpretation: 2 of 3 BRRI research conditions were met. The full research screening condition was not satisfied.
models.source: Bangladesh Rice Research Institute Research Progress 2023-2024
